features.title: Enable Banking access spike and sandbox fixtures
features.user_visible_behavior: Enable Banking sandbox access works for Nordea FI and S-Pankki: an application whose RSA private key lives in `secrets/` (gitignored) authorises against both mock banks and fetches accounts, balances and transactions. Anonymised responses are committed under `tests/fixtures/enable-banking/`, and the facts later features depend on (consent validity, history depth, fetch limits, pending support, restricted-production terms) are recorded in this ticket's Findings.

features.title: Connect-bank flow
features.user_visible_behavior: `/connections` lists connections (bank, status, consent expiry, last sync) and connects Nordea or S-Pankki: the app redirects to the bank with a server-stored state, `/connections/callback` validates the state, creates the session and stores the encrypted session id, institution and accounts, and I can name accounts and mark them checking or savings. A cancelled or invalid callback shows an error; a connection can be removed (revoked at the provider) or archived with its history.

features.title: Sync accounts and balances
features.user_visible_behavior: `syncBalances(connectionId)` adds new accounts, archives vanished ones, upserts one balance snapshot per account per day and balance type, writes a `sync_runs` row with status and counts, updates `last_synced_at`, and marks the connection expired instead of failing when the provider reports an auth error.

features.title: Sync transactions
features.user_visible_behavior: `syncTransactions(connectionId)` backfills from the oldest available date, then syncs incrementally from `last_synced_at` minus a 7-day overlap; it upserts on `provider_txn_ref` with `dedupe_hash` as fallback, replaces pending transactions with their booked version, removes stale pending ones, never overwrites manual category or note edits, follows pagination and records fetched / inserted / updated counts in `sync_runs`. Running it twice changes nothing.

L1: pnpm test:unit tests/unit/sync/transaction-merge.test.ts (pending to booked matching, overlap window, missing provider ids)

features.title: Scheduled sync, Sync now and sync log
features.user_visible_behavior: The worker runs a `bank-sync` job on `SYNC_CRON` (default every 6 hours) for every active connection; a Postgres advisory lock prevents two syncs of one connection at once, and a failing connection is logged and retried on the next tick without stopping the others or crashing the worker. A Sync now button on the dashboard and `/connections` runs the same sync with a pending state, the first sync runs right after connecting, the connection page shows the last sync runs (status, duration, counts, errors) and the header shows the last successful sync.

features.title: Categorization engine and own-transfer detection
features.user_visible_behavior: Seeded two-level default categories and rules for common Finnish merchants categorise new transactions after every sync and import; rules match counterparty or description (contains, equals, regex) and optionally amount sign or range, applied by priority, first match wins; manual categories are never overwritten; re-apply rules recategorises all non-manual transactions. A debit and a credit of the same absolute amount between my own accounts within ±3 days (or to an own IBAN) are linked as a transfer pair with the Transfers category and excluded from spending and income.
